status_summary: E&E News reported on 2025-06-26 that DOE was emphasizing AI, quantum, fusion and fission at the labs, while the FY2026 request proposed deep cuts to applied renewable and hydrogen work at NREL, NETL and PNNL. Congress enacted 8.25 billion dollars for the Office of Science in FY2026 (Public Law 119-74, 2026-01-23), about level with FY2025 and about 1.16 billion above the request, per CRS. The FY2027 request seeks 7.14 billion dollars for the Office of Science, a 13 percent cut, and AI supercomputers funded from previously appropriated hydrogen hub money, per AIP on 2026-04-22. On 2026-08-14 trade press reported DOE had issued updated lab operating directives removing outdated and duplicative requirements. The sources reviewed show no formal consolidation of the lab network.
